<thought>From the 13C NMR data, peaks in the aromatic region (≈110‑160 ppm) are at 144.78, 132.00, 130.07 (two peaks), and 127.80 (two peaks). That totals 6 aromatic carbon signals. The other peaks correspond to carbonyl or aliphatic carbons. Therefore, the molecule contains 6 aromatic carbon atoms.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
